text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 3% over the past day, signaling modest profit-taking despite overall greed sentiment in the market. Bitcoin dominance holding at 58.6% suggests traders are rotating within major assets rather than fleeing to stablecoins, and the $120B daily volume supports orderly trading without panic. The Fear & Greed index at 71 with a strong 7-day climb indicates bullish conviction remains intact, so this pullback appears to be consolidation within a broader uptrend rather than a shift in mood.
